name: claude-usage-monitor
description: See your Claude usage on the Free plan: 5-hour and 7-day percentages with reset times, read from the desktop app’s own local cache. No network, no API key.
long_description:
Unofficial Claude Desktop extension (MCPB). The Claude desktop app shows no usage percentage on the Free plan; this fills that gap: hover the tray icon for your 5-hour / weekly usage and reset times, or ask Claude to call the claude_usage tool in a conversation. It reads only the local cache the desktop app writes under %APPDATA%\Claude\IndexedDB — no network, no API key, no sessionKey, never touches your conversations.

非官方 Claude Desktop 扩展。官方界面不给免费用户显示额度，本扩展补上这块：托盘图标悬停即看 5 小时 / 每周用量与重置时间，或在对话中让 Claude 调用 claude_usage 工具。只读取 Claude 桌面版自己写在 %APPDATA%\Claude\IndexedDB 下的本地缓存，不联网、不需要 API Key、不碰聊天内容。

tools.name: claude_usage
tools.description: Read the local Claude Desktop cache: 5-hour session and 7-day weekly usage percentage and reset times (会话 / 每周用量与重置时间)
